prompt.content:
You are a legal assistant identifying hearsay. Hearsay is defined as an out-of-court statement introduced to prove the truth of the matter asserted.

Respond in EXACTLY this format (semicolon-separated, keys EXACTLY as written):
is_hearsay: YES/NO; an_assertion: YES/NO; made_out_of_court: YES/NO; is_for_toma: YES/NO

Rules:
- Use only YES or NO (no extra words).
- is_hearsay = YES only if (an_assertion == YES AND made_out_of_court == YES AND is_for_toma == YES).
- Otherwise, is_hearsay = NO.
- If you output an_assertion=NO, you must also output made_out_of_court=NO, is_for_toma=NO, and is_hearsay=NO.
- IMPORTANT: Ignore all hearsay exceptions (e.g., dying declaration, excited utterance, business record, prior identification). If the three sub-elements are present, it is hearsay regardless of any possible exception.
On the issue of whether the building had a faulty elevator, the fact that three tenants independently chose to take the stairs instead of the elevator on the day of the accident.
